--IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'ACCOUNT_OTH') 
--BEGIN
--   DROP TABLE DW.ACCOUNT_OTH;
--END;


WITH ACCOUNT_SK
AS(
SELECT ISNULL(MAX(AccountSk),0) RN FROM DW.DIMACCOUNT 

)
, CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter 
AS(
    SELECT A.* FROM BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter A
	JOIN (SELECT CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode, MAX(Timestamp) Timestamp FROM BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode ) B
	ON A.CustomerAccountId = B.CustomerAccountId AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND A.Timestamp = B.Timestamp AND A.SourceSystemCode = B.SourceSystemCode
    WHERE A.ProfitCostCenterTypeId = 'Account PCC Code 1' AND A.SourceSystemCode NOT IN ('TRU','DEP','LNS')
)
, CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL
AS(
    SELECT A.* FROM BNKM.CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL A
	JOIN (SELECT CUSTOMERACCOUNTID, FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode, MAX(Timestamp) Timestamp FROM BNKM.CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL GROUP BY CUSTOMERACCOUNTID, FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode ) B
	ON A.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = B.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND A.Timestamp = B.Timestamp AND A.SourceSystemCode = B.SourceSystemCode
    WHERE A.SourceSystemCode NOT IN ('TRU','DEP','LNS')
)

SELECT
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM ACCOUNT_SK) AS AccountSK
,* 
--INTO DW.ACCOUNT_OTH
FROM ( 
    
SELECT DISTINCT 
BCA.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,BCA.CustomerAccountName AS AccountName
,BCA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate AS AccountOpenedDate
,BCAS.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId AS AccountStatus
,CASE 
     WHEN BCAF.FINANCIALPRODUCTID IN ('00013','01013') OR BCCA.EmployeePayrollAccountIndicator = 'Y' 
     THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PayrollIndicator
,BCA.IsoCurrencyCode AS CurrencyCode
,BCCC.ProfitCostCenterId AS ProfitCostCode
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDBRAN.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,BCA.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm

FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerAccountId,CustomerAccountName,CustomerAccountOpenedDate,IsoCurrencyCode,SourceSystemCode,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,BRANCHID FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount) BCA 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNTFINANCIALPRODUCT BCAF ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = convert(varchar,BCAF.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID) AND BCAF.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode  AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCAF.FinancialInstitutionId AND (BCAF.PERIODENDDATE IS NULL OR BCAF.PERIODENDDATE = '1900-01-01' ) --NO DATA
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNTSTATUS BCAS ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCAS.CustomerAccountId AND BCAS.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode AND BCAS.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID AND (BCAS.PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL OR BCAS.PeriodEndTimestamp = '1900-01-01' )
LEFT JOIN CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL BCCA ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = BCCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID AND BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = BCCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCCA.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = DDB.BANKID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBRAN ON BCA.BRANCHID = DDBRAN.BRANCHID AND DDBRAN.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter BCCC ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCCC.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCCC.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCCC.SourceSystemCode AND BCCC.ProfitCostCenterTypeId = 'Account PCC Code 1'
WHERE BCA.SourceSystemCode NOT IN ('TRU','DEP','LNS')
)a



WITH
TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT_SRC
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     CONVERT(VARCHAR,AccountID)
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,AccountName)
    ,CONVERT(DATE,AccountOpenedDate)
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,AccountStatus)
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PayrollIndicator)
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,CurrencyCode)
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,ProfitCostCode)
    ,CONVERT(INT,BankSK)
    ,CONVERT(INT,BranchSK)
    )) HASHROW, AccountID,BankSK ,SourceSystemCode
    FROM DW.ACCOUNT_OTH
)
,
TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT_TGT
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     CONVERT(VARCHAR,AccountID)
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,AccountName)
    ,CONVERT(DATE,AccountOpenedDate)
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,AccountStatus)
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PayrollIndicator)
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,CurrencyCode)
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,ProfitCostCode)
    ,CONVERT(INT,BankSK)
    ,CONVERT(INT,BranchSK)
    )) HASHROW, AccountID,BankSK ,SourceSystemCode
    FROM DW.DIMACCOUNT WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1 AND SourceSystemCode NOT IN ('TRU','DEP','LNS')
)

    SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.AccountID,TGT.AccountID) AS AccountID
	,ISNULL(SRC.BankSK,TGT.BankSK) AS BankSK
	,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
	,CASE
        WHEN  TGT.BankSK IS NULL AND TGT.AccountID IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
--INTO DW.TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT_DELTA_OTH 	
FROM TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT_SRC SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT_TGT	TGT
ON SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK
AND SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR ( TGT.BANKSK IS NULL AND TGT.AccountID IS NULL)


INSERT INTO DW.DIMACCOUNT
(
 AccountSK
,AccountID
,AccountName
,AccountOpenedDate
,AccountStatus
,PayrollIndicator
,CurrencyCode
,ProfitCostCode
,BankSK
,BranchSK
,SourceSystemCode
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)
SELECT DISTINCT
AccountSK
,SRC.AccountID
,AccountName
,AccountOpenedDate
,AccountStatus
,PayrollIndicator
,CurrencyCode
,ProfitCostCode
,SRC.BankSK
,BranchSK
,SRC.SourceSystemCode
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
FROM DW.ACCOUNT_OTH SRC
JOIN DW.TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT_DELTA_OTH DELTA ON  DELTA.BankSK = SRC.BankSK AND DELTA.AccountID = SRC.AccountID AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');
